name: Manabe Akihito
source:
Manabe Akihito is the gloomy younger brother of Fukamachi's dead girlfriend. He visits Fukamachi's household often to find out the truth about his sister's death, though always leaves displeased in the end. He has come to dislike Fukamachi because of this.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kannagi_no_Tori]Wikipedia[/url]]
